step_reports.summary: Added l2_fixture_py.text.slugify implementing lowercase conversion and collapsing of non-alphanumeric runs into single hyphens, with leading/trailing hyphens stripped. All three acceptance criteria are covered by targeted tests, which pass, and code review found no standards or spec issues.

diff:
diff --git a/src/l2_fixture_py/text.py b/src/l2_fixture_py/text.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3b7640d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/l2_fixture_py/text.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+
+_SEPARATOR_RUN = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")
+
+
+def slugify(text: str) -> str:
+    return _SEPARATOR_RUN.sub("-", text.lower()).strip("-")
diff --git a/tests/test_text.py b/tests/test_text.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..53a5b9b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_text.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+from l2_fixture_py.text import slugify
+
+
+def test_slugify_basic_title() -> None:
+    assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
+
+
+def test_slugify_collapses_runs_of_separators() -> None:
+    assert slugify("a  --  b") == "a-b"
+
+
+def test_slugify_strips_leading_and_trailing_separators() -> None:
+    assert slugify("  -Hi-  ") == "hi"
